svg.title: Сгибание кистей с гантелями — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two close side-three-quarter poses of seated wrist curls. Forearms supinated PALMS UP on thighs, wrists free beyond knees, one dumbbell each hand. Start wrists extended down, finish flex wrists up without moving forearms. Show full dumbbells and elbows. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
